exercise.title: Siren to Sol
exercise.why: A slow slide passes through every pitch on the way, so it shows your voice the whole distance it needs to skip.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below to start the drone and the mic. On "oo", slide slowly from the low {{1}} up to {{5}} and back, like a siren.
Then sing the two as a clean skip, with no slide between them.
_Don't reach for high notes: turn the siren round at {{5}}._
